criteria: Score demonstrated ops skill only. High systems_ops: Hyper-V, RMM (Breeze/Datto/ConnectWise/Ninja), firewalls, DNS, backup restore proof. High troubleshooting: ticket examples with RCA, not 'good with people'. High automation: scripts that survived production, not a lab hello-world. Personal GitHub repos are not OSS. Certs without evidence of use are weak.
notes: Primary inbound rubric for Safeguard hires. Ignore school name, GPA, city. Rank only. Do not auto-reject.

high_bar.systems_ops: Named hypervisor + RMM + firewall/DNS with production years. Backup restore proof beats a cert list.
high_bar.troubleshooting: One real ticket RCA with symptom, cause, fix, and customer impact. PSA/RMM ticket ID or equivalent.
high_bar.automation: One production script (PowerShell preferred) with runtime, endpoint count, or hours saved.
high_bar.production_experience: MSP or internal IT production, not a lab or class. Years and stack named.
high_bar.technical_breadth: Cloud or backup or security used on real clients, not listed as a skill only.

pass_moves: Put Hyper-V/RMM/firewall in experience bullets with numbers, not a skills dump
One ransomware/backup restore or P2V/failover RCA with outcome
One production script with runtime or endpoint count
Skip GitHub unless it is real OSS; empty GitHub is better than tutorial repos
